description: A space between the opening marker and the newline does not start a heredoc
notes: The spec's grammar puts a Newline after the opening identifier but doesn't say whether whitespace may come before it, while whitespace between lexical elements is generally ignored. hashicorp/hcl requires the newline right after the identifier (BeginHeredocTmpl in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl) and otherwise doesn't recognize a heredoc.
